mapper.sql: INSERT INTO accounts ( account_code, kind, status, parent_code, ledger_type, currency, is_auto_captured, is_auto_settled, platform_fee_fixed, platform_fee_bps, profile ) VALUES ( #{accountCode}, #{kind}, #{status}, #{parentCode}, #{ledgerType}, #{currency}, #{isAutoCaptured}, #{isAutoSettled}, #{platformFeeFixed}, #{platformFeeBps}, CAST(#{profile} AS jsonb) )
mapper.select: SELECT account_code, kind, status, parent_code, ledger_type, currency, is_auto_captured, is_auto_settled, platform_fee_fixed, platform_fee_bps, profile::text AS profile FROM accounts WHERE account_code = #{accountCode} AND kind = 'MERCHANT'
